basis: Kadant’s April 29 earnings release explicitly forecast consolidated Q2 2025 revenue of $243 million to $250 million. The high end was $11,026,750 below the cutoff of $261,026,750, calculated as 95% of reported Q2 2024 revenue of $274,765,000. The entire forecast range qualified.

coverage.detail: The December 12, 2024 Investor Day presentation gave a 2028 revenue target of $1.5 billion to $1.8 billion in its five-year plan. It supplied no Q2 2025 revenue ceiling.
The February 12, 2025 earnings release forecast Q1 2025 revenue of $235 million to $242 million and full-year revenue of $1.040 billion to $1.065 billion. Neither range established a Q2 upper bound.
On the February 13 earnings call, the CFO expected Q1 to be the weakest quarter and the second half to be stronger than the first. His remarks gave no numeric ceiling for Q2 revenue.

The April 29 release states, “For the second quarter of 2025, we expect revenue of $243 to $250 million.” This company-wide revenue forecast appears separately from adjusted EPS and the revised full-year outlook.
Slide 16 of the Q1 earnings webcast presentation repeats the $243 million to $250 million Q2 revenue range. The April 30 call followed publication of the range on April 29.
The July 24 notice scheduled the Q2 release for July 29 and the call for July 30. It contained no preliminary revenue figure. The intervening disclosure search found no updated Q2 revenue range.

The July 29 release’s consolidated statement of income reports $255,267,000 for the three months ended June 28, 2025 and $274,765,000 for the three months ended June 29, 2024. Reported revenue exceeded the April forecast but fell 7.10% year over year, confirming the threshold on the GAAP basis.

publication_date_evidence: Kadant’s investor-relations page timestamps the qualifying release April 29, 2025 at 4:43 PM EDT. Its April 29 dateline and the same-day SEC Exhibit 99.1 corroborate the public date.
